invariants.name: accounting_identity
invariants.informal: The vault's gross aToken balance must exactly equal the net assets backing shareholders plus all protocol-claimable fees, with no value leaking to or from either bucket.

invariants.name: fee_bounded_by_atoken_holdings
invariants.informal: Claimable fees can never exceed the vault's real aToken holdings, preventing the protocol from claiming value it does not possess.

invariants.name: solvency_nonzero_supply
invariants.informal: Any non-zero outstanding share supply must be backed by a strictly positive net asset base.

invariants.name: last_vault_balance_le_actual
invariants.informal: The last-snapshotted vault balance never exceeds the current real aToken balance because aTokens only accrue yield between snapshots.

invariants.name: fee_rate_bounded_by_scale
invariants.informal: The fee rate cannot exceed 100% of yield (SCALE = 1e18), guaranteeing shareholders always retain a non-negative net portion of any yield when the fee is below maximum.

invariants.name: per_account_share_conservation
invariants.informal: No single account's share balance can exceed the total share supply, preserving additive conservation across all holders.

invariants.name: total_assets_net_of_fees_non_negative
invariants.informal: The vault's aToken balance is never less than accrued fees, ensuring that the subtraction in totalAssets() cannot underflow and that shareholder assets remain non-negative.

invariants.name: shares_backed_proportionally
invariants.informal: The per-share asset value derived from totalAssets and totalSupply never implies more aggregate assets than the vault actually holds, ruling out phantom value creation.
